column1: # console-oracle cases: libSceNet byte order and address text, libSceHttp URI helpers, libSceSystemService settings.
# No socket is opened and no request is made; every case is a function of its arguments (or, for a system setting,
# libSceNet byte order and address text: pure functions.
# libSceHttp URI helpers: pure string functions. out may be NULL to ask for the size needed.
# libSceSystemService: a parameter initialiser, and settings queried by id. Only the return code is compared for a setting.
